findings.title: Wire the new timeout setting into the shutdown drain
findings.body: A supported value such as shutdown_drain_timeout=120.5 is accepted but never consumed. scheduler.py:70–81 still derives the timeout solely from the environment at import time, and line 634 uses that constant. With no environment override, shutdown therefore forces resource closure after 60 seconds even when the configured drain budget is longer. The field's claimed configuration behavior is missing.
